newsitem.title: UK: Regulator probes British Gas credit card - report.
newsitem.headline: Regulator probes British Gas credit card - report.

text.p: The UK's gas regulator has begun an investigation into a credit card launched last month by a joint venture between British Gas and HFC Bank, the Times newspaper reported on Thursday.
Regulator Ofgas has received a number of complaints about the Goldfish credit card have passed these on to British Gas, the report said.
Ofgas plans to issued a consultation document on the issue in the next few days and the card eventually could have to be withdrawn, the report added.

The card was launched last month when British Gas and HFC, a subsidiary of U.S. consumer finance company Household International Inc, formed a 50-50 joint venture to market financial services products.
The venture marked British Gas' first major diversification beyond its core energy business.
Cardholders can build up points that can be used to gain a discount on gas bills.
The Times quoted a British Gas spokesman as saying: "It really is not a loyalty card. It is offered by a company outside British Gas."
